scope: Eight-aircraft, two-base, 43-day no-failure regression derived from accepted F03.var01 staffed fleet; one frozen input is run twice independently. Earlier v1.0.0 used IPER48 with IQTY21 and is excluded for compressed 2.2857-hour requests.

expected_converter.basis: Accepted G12.var01 zero-FRT item precedent; any different diagnostic excludes the run.

parameters.schedule: 21 two-wave BASE-01 cycles and 21 BASE-02 single-aircraft requests; both root profiles use IQTY21/IPER1008, targeting 48-hour spacing

expected_timeline: Accepted A09/F03 profile behavior divides IPER by IQTY. With 1008/21, BASE-01 risk and BASIC requests are targeted at h21.5 and h24.75 plus multiples of 48; BASE-02 targets h8 plus multiples of 48. Actual starts may wait on PM/resources and must be read from native events.
Zero explicit system/item failure rates and zero MissionType.MFF should yield no random failures or item backorders; native events and converter must confirm.
Eight aircraft receive CAL24 calendar PM and operate over 1032 hours. PM starts/completions, mission outcomes, resource queues and terminal state must be observed rather than presumed.
acceptance_hypotheses: Two fresh serial guarded SSH0/mutex/GUI13340 runs import/export/calculate/report with zero conversion errors and no unreviewed diagnostics, exact populated-table roundtrips, nonempty native output, and raw SHA closures.

The two independent runs use one byte-identical source and produce matching typed mission/PM/resource event timelines and aggregate reports; no random failure events, backorders or stock transports appear.

All 2064 half-hour System, Stock and Resource report bins, mission counts and durations, resource leases/queues and terminal state reconcile with the native event log. No conclusion about random statistical stability, accuracy targets, unfinished states or GUI behavior follows from this deterministic slice.
